ingredientSections.heading: Citric Acid Solution
items: 1½ tsp Citric Acid (from specialty grocers or cooking stores)

methodSections.heading: Blushing Sicilian
steps: Add all ingredients except the wine to cocktail shaker, shake and strain, into flute.
Top with the sparkling wine. Garnish with blood orange peel swath.

methodSections.heading: Blood Orange Syrup
steps: Juice the Blood Oranges and strain.
Measure the juice and add half that amount of water.
Measure the amount of blood orange juice and water when combined.
Add an equal amount of sugar to the liquid. For example, if you have 150ml of liquid add 150g of sugar.
On a medium heat bring the liquid to a simmer.
Once the syrup has started bubbling, but before it boils, make sure the sugar has dissolved, remove from heat and let the mixture cool before bottling.
